unit.why: A single tale about a Jewish community in Brzeżnica (Barazhnits) threatened with annihilation after a stone is thrown at the duke, saved when a simple man confesses and is revealed as the reincarnation of Ishmael ben Nethaniah; no Hasidic figures appear.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with the book's closing colophon (תמו ספורים הנוראים... סליק), which is paratext

stories.start_quote: מעשה נורא שקרה במדינת פולין בעיר באראזניץ
stories.summary_en: When the Jews of Barazhnits are condemned to death because someone threw a stone at the duke in the Jewish street, a simple Jew confesses, insists he alone is guilty, and is hanged; before dying he asks that his tombstone read 'here lies Ishmael son of Nethaniah who killed Gedaliah', revealing that he was that murderer's reincarnation, punished measure for measure.

quotes: כי היה גלגול ישמעאל בן נתניה
tags.why: The man is revealed as the reincarnation of Ishmael ben Nethaniah.

quotes: ותדעו כי באמת חייב אני מיתה כזו
tags.why: His death is retribution for Gedaliah's murder in a former life.

quotes: על כן גזר על כל היהודים להשמידם
וילכו עמו ראשי הקהל אל פקיד העיר
tags.why: The duke issues a decree, and the community deals with the town official and the judges.

quotes: ויאמר לו הדוכס מה עשיתי לך רעה
tags.why: The man is interrogated by the duke and his judges.

quotes: על כן גזר על כל היהודים להשמידם מנער ועד זקן
tags.why: A hostile decree is issued against the Jewish community.

quotes: גזרו צום וקראו אל ה׳ בחזקה

tags.why: The community cries out to God in supplication.

quotes: ונגמר דינו למיתה והכינו תלייה ברחוב העיר
ואז הבינו העם כי היה גלגול
tags.why: Only afterwards do the people understand who he really was and why he confessed.

quotes: בשנת שלשים ושש למאה הרביעית רכב הדוכס
tags.why: The tale is set as a dated local event, an anti-Jewish decree.

quotes: ואשים קן לימי לכפר על עוני
tags.why: He gives his life to atone for a past sin.

quotes: כי יראתי כי לא יהי' תלוי בי
tags.why: He fears bearing guilt for the deaths of many Jews.

missing_concepts: self-sacrifice to save the community (מסירות נפש / false confession)
biblical figure reincarnated (Ishmael ben Nethaniah / Gedaliah)
tombstone inscription as a revelation device
